name: port-nosignal
summary: v4: declare an input "no signal" after 2.5 s (DP / USB-C, vendor 8 s) and 2.5 s (HDMI, vendor 10 s): faster automatic switching and a faster way to standby; requires nosignal-once
status: untested (v4; v3 HDMI-only 6 s in daily use)

edits.asm: sub_260E0E ori r5,r0,0x1f4 -> ori r5,r0,0x7d (port +0x1A no-signal threshold, type bit3/4/0x400 (HDMI), normal case)
sub_260E0E ori r5,r0,0x190 -> ori r5,r0,0x7d (port +0x1A no-signal threshold, type 0x20 (USB-C, DP), normal case)

notes: Port +0x1A thresholds set by sub_260E0E (vendor: 400 passes for type 0x20 = ports 0 USB-C and 1 DP, 500 for types bit3/4/0x400 = ports 2-5, 200 in the flag case). v4: type 0x20 -> 125, ports 2-5 -> 125 (normal case); the flag case stays 200. LG 28MQ780 uses 100. Accept thresholds (+0x18, see port-accept) unchanged. Generated by tools/patches_src_port_nosignal.py (NOSIG_DP=n, NOSIG=n, 50-400/500).
